configurations._comment: Serves the PRODUCTION build in dist/ (astro preview), not a dev server. Needed to verify anything gated on a real production build: GA4 and the Intercom Messenger only render when import.meta.env.PROD (src/layouts/BaseLayout.astro). Build first with the ids baked in, e.g. PUBLIC_GA_MEASUREMENT_ID=G-TEST PUBLIC_INTERCOM_APP_ID=a185fzec pnpm build
